[[Drago's Flatbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Drago Stoneherder]], a [[boss]] who is found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
Drago's Flatbow has the same skin as a [[Recurve Bow (weapon)|Recurve Bow]], but it is much larger than usual. This skin is also shared by the [[Greater Sturdy Bow]], which can only be acquired from [[Tolkano]].
